content: Mobile App Development: Cross-platform via Flutter (Dart) or React Native (Expo). Native iOS via Swift/SwiftUI. Native Android via Kotlin/Jetpack Compose. State Management: Riverpod/Bloc (Flutter), Zustand/Redux (RN). Navigation: GoRouter (Flutter), Expo Router (RN). Local Storage: Hive (Flutter), AsyncStorage (RN). Push Notifications: Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM).
